Hi Sophie — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align engineering tests with your SRE team: 

Call highlights:
- You run conversational search across product pages (~1.2M monthly queries) and care most about median p95 latency and cold-start behaviour across regions.
- Current infra: mixed hyperscaler endpoints (Vertex + Bedrock) with regional fallbacks; concerns on cross-region tail spikes and egress costs.
- Primary constraints: <220ms p95 (US/EU traffic) for short prompts (<128 tokens), data residency in APAC (Singapore) for a subset of traffic.

What we propose next (concrete tests):
1) Multi-region latency split: benchmark Redwood hosted endpoint vs your Bedrock/Vertex baseline in three regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1) using identical prompt set + request pacing.
2) Cold-start spike window: run 30m low-traffic window followed by a 10m burst to capture warmup behavior and KV-cache efficacy.
3) Token-cost vs latency sweep: compare quantized variants (int8) and a float16 baseline to show unit-cost tradeoffs for your workload.

Data & logistics:
- Attached: redwood-latency-one-pager.pdf (high-level summary) and shoplane-initial-telemetry.csv (sample traces you shared)
- We will need a contact on your infra/SRE side to coordinate VPC/peering or IP allowlist for synthetic tests.
- Proposed windows: Oct 6-8 (APAC evening), Oct 11-12 (US daytime) — flexible if you prefer alternatives.

Next steps / asks for Sophie:
- Confirm SRE contact for allowlist and whether we can run synthetic traffic from Redwood-managed probes (we can also accept test harness you run).
- Confirm whether the APAC residency requirement is for storage only or also for inference execution.

Happy to jump on a 15-min sync tomorrow to lock the test windows.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).
- Variants: Redwood quantized-int8, Redwood float16 baseline, Bedrock baseline, Vertex baseline.
